test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Heat Engine) Official Paper (Held On 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT about end standard?

options.text: It is slower but more accurate.
It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines.
It measures the distance between two parallel flat surfaces.

solution:
The correct answer is __Option 3**(It is used to measure the distance between two engraved lines)**.__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• End standards__ are used for precise measurement.
 
• They measure the distance between two parallel flat surfaces.
 
• The faces of end standards are subject to wear, which makes them less durable over time.
 
• While slower, they provide accurate results compared to other methods.
 
• End standards are not used to measure the distance between engraved lines; they are specifically designed for flat surface measurements.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Line Standards:**

 
 
• Line standards involve measuring the distance between two engraved lines.
 
• They are less accurate compared to end standards.
 
 
 
• **Slip Gauges:**
 
 
• Slip gauges are used as end standards for precision measurement.
 
• They consist of a stackable set of gauges providing flexibility in measurements.
